description: This Java class serves as an example generator producing various JSON representations of objects used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It creates JSON files for policies, things, search models, and various command, event, and exception messages relevant to the project, primarily for testing or documentation purposes.

classes.name: JsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A utility class that generates sample JSON representations of Ditto policies, things, and command/event messages for testing or documentation purposes.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initiates the JSON example production process, accepting command line arguments specifying output directory.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Loads the output directory argument and starts the production of JSON examples.

methods.name: produce
methods.description: Main method to generate various categories of JSON examples including policies, things, search models, messages, and exceptions.

methods.name: producePolicyCommands
methods.description: Generates JSON files for policy-related command messages.

methods.name: producePolicyQueryCommands
methods.description: Generates JSON files for policy query commands.

methods.description: Generates JSON responses for policy query commands.

methods.name: producePolicyModifyCommands
methods.description: Generates JSON files for policy modify commands.

methods.name: producePolicyModifyResponse
methods.description: Generates JSON responses for policy modification commands.

methods.name: producePolicyEvents
methods.description: Creates JSON files for policy-related event messages.

methods.name: producePolicyExceptions
methods.description: Creates JSON files for various policy-related exception messages.

methods.name: produceThingCommands
methods.description: Generates JSON files for thing-related command messages.

methods.description: Creates JSON files for thing query commands.

methods.name: produceThingModifyCommands
methods.description: Creates JSON files for thing modification commands.

methods.name: produceThingModifyResponses
methods.description: Creates JSON files for responses to thing modification commands.

methods.name: produceSearchCommands

methods.name: produceSearchExceptions

methods.name: producePolicyQueryCommands
methods.description: Generates JSON files for various policy query command message examples.

methods.name: produceJsonExceptions
methods.description: Generates JSON examples for JSON parse/validation exceptions.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Utility method to serialize a Jsonifiable object to a file with optional schema version.
